title: Geisha and Emerald Dog
description: A surreal painting features a geisha with white face paint and elaborate green and red hair ornaments applying red pigment to her face. A vibrant green dog with glowing red eyes stands beside her, reaching toward a large cracked mirror reflecting a face with red eyes. Behind them is a traditional Japanese shop with red roof and hanging lanterns, set within a circular frame of lush green leaves against a swirling sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a traditional Japanese geisha with white makeup and elaborate green-red hair ornaments applying red pigment to her cheek. A glowing emerald green dog with red eyes stands on its hind legs reaching toward a large cracked oval mirror that reflects a face with intense red eyes. In the background a small shop with red roof and hanging lanterns, all framed by a circular border of lush green leaves and vines, dramatic swirling sky above, rich vibrant colors, detailed painting style.
